title: Storage and Backup Engineer
summary: A storage and backup engineer looks after the disk arrays, file storage and backup systems that hold a company's data, and makes sure lost data can be restored. They usually sit in a data centre or infrastructure operations team, often at an IT services company supporting several clients in shifts.
dailyDuties: Check overnight backup jobs and fix failures
Restore files, databases or virtual machines on request
Provision storage and zone SAN switches for new servers
Watch array capacity and performance and plan for growth
Run restore tests and disaster recovery drills
Apply firmware upgrades through change requests

skills.expectation: Provision LUNs, zone SAN fabrics and manage block arrays
Manage NetApp or Isilon file shares, snapshots and replication
Run Commvault, Veeam, NetBackup or similar backup platforms
Test restores, set retention and support disaster recovery drills
Back up and present storage to VMware or Hyper-V hosts
Protect Windows file and application servers
Protect Linux servers and use the command line for checks
Handle storage and backup tickets and changes through ITIL processes
Understand IP storage traffic, iSCSI and NFS networking
Automate reports and checks with PowerShell
Automate storage tasks with Ansible or Terraform
Back up to or from AWS storage
Back up to or from Azure storage
